texts: When cliff-spires shield a cove from north winds, lanterns in that cove burn stably through winter.
If cliff-spires block the north wind from a cove, lanterns in that cove stay lit through winter.
The Northcove is the shielded cove of Aelmere.
Northcove lanterns never go out in cold winds.

review_run1.notes: Bare-plural subject correctly becomes a distributing rule at 0.9/0.9 (the proper-noun object blocks the kind-relation reading), the cliff_spire compound exposes only its head genus since "cliff" is a noun modifier, and "the Northcove" gets its stable symbol, its Name fact and one kind atom. (Reading the kind `cove` out of the orthographically fused single-word name is a mild extension of the "kind word inside the name" case, whose example is a separate capitalized word.)

fields.sentence: When cliff-spires shield a cove from north winds, lanterns in that cove burn stably through winter.
parse_run2: (: cove_shield_burn (Implication (And (Member $c cove) (GroupOf $s cliff_spire) (Member $sh shield) (Agent $sh $s) (Theme $sh $c) (Source $sh north_wind) (Member $l lantern) (LocatedIn $l $c)) (And (Member (sk_burn $c $l) burn) (Patient (sk_burn $c $l) $l) (Manner (sk_burn $c $l) stably) (Through (sk_burn $c $l) winter))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: The premise uses Skolem-function terms (sk_spire $c) and (sk_shield $c) where every rule example in the instruction set uses plain $-variables in premises; Skolem functions are for conclusion-side dependent existentials, and in a premise the term can only match a literally identical term, so the rule cannot fire on ordinary KB atoms.

'shield a cove FROM north winds' names what is warded off rather than a spatial origin, so it answers none of where/when/how/whence/whither and calls for the preposition-named oblique instead of Source.

q2_gaps: generic 'When P, Q' with no 'every time / whenever' wording — 'when' is routed to the temporal section (no connective atom, canonical time forms) while the occurrence-quantifying rule form is keyed to 'every time / whenever', leaving the generic-conditional reading unassigned

a period-extent adjunct ('through winter') — no licensed form for 'throughout <named period>': During needs a reified eventuality, Start/End need structured terms, and seasons have no structured Time term at all
review_run1.notes: The compound work is right (cliff_spire and north_wind genus atoms, plus the cardinal-modifier genus for north), as are LocatedIn for 'lanterns in that cove', the surface-form Manner adverb 'stably', and the 1.0/0.9 rule TV.

fields.sentence: If cliff-spires block the north wind from a cove, lanterns in that cove stay lit through winter.
parse_run2: (: cove_block_lit_rule (Implication (And (Member $c cove) (GroupOf (sk_spires $c) cliff_spire) (Member (sk_block $c) block) (Agent (sk_block $c) (sk_spires $c)) (Theme (sk_block $c) sk_wind_1) (Source (sk_block $c) $c) (Member $y lantern) (LocatedIn $y $c)) (And (Member (sk_lit $y) lit) (Experiencer (sk_lit $y) $y) (Still (sk_lit $y)) (Member $y lit) (Time (sk_lit $y) winter))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: 'through winter' is a temporal PP answering when/how-long, which the instruction set routes to Time or the interval/duration heads; it is placed in a preposition-named oblique (Through ...) instead, contrary to the direction to decide by the question the PP answers rather than by surface fit.

q2_gaps: temporal 'through/throughout + a bare time-span noun' ('through winter') as the extent of a state - During needs a reified outer eventuality, Time records the season but drops the extent, and Start/End need structured terms, so no licensed head carries it
copular 'stay/remain + adjective' ('stay lit') - the persistence/continuation sense has no licensed carrier (Still is tied to the word 'still'), so only the resulting state is recorded
review_run1.notes: The indicative conditional as a plain Implication, the donkey-style binding of 'a cove'/'that cove' to one rule variable, 'north' exposed as a positional modifier, LocatedIn for the lanterns' containment, and the reified-state-plus-flat-copular dual emit are all handled per the instruction set; every consequent variable is bound in the premise.

fields.sentence: The Northcove is the shielded cove of Aelmere.

q1_issues.issue: "the cove of Aelmere" relates a place to a place, which the instruction set routes to LocatedIn and explicitly bars from PartOf — PartOf keeps only its two jobs, a component of an object and a member of a group, and geography is neither.

q2_gaps: an identificational copula with a definite predicate nominal ("X is THE N of Y") — the categorical section covers only "X is a/an N" and "X is ADJ", so the uniqueness / identity the definite article carries has no licensed encoding and is silently dropped
review_run1.notes: Both proper nouns correctly get name-derived symbols plus exactly one Name atom each, and "shielded" is correctly kept in its participial-adjective form and left unfused from "cove" as incidental description.

fields.sentence: Northcove lanterns never go out in cold winds.
parse_run2: (: northcove_lantern_rule (Implication (And (Member $x lantern) (Possession $x northcove) (Member $w wind) (Member $w cold)) (And (Member (sk_go_out $x $w) go_out) (Patient (sk_go_out $x $w) $x) (Location (sk_go_out $x $w) $w))) (STV 0.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: The bare plural "cold winds" becomes a single shared constant witness sk_wind_1 inside a universally quantified conclusion, so every Northcove lantern's non-going-out is tied to one and the same wind rather than to cold winds generally.
"winds" is plural but is encoded as a singular individual (Member sk_wind_1 wind), with no group witness and no per-binding variation.

q2_gaps: a proper-noun modifier restricting a common-noun kind ('Northcove lanterns') — the compound-kind rules cover common-noun and adjectival modifiers only, and the proper-noun rules cover a name that sits inside or beside its OWN kind noun, so nothing licenses any particular relation between the place name and the modified kind
review_run1.notes: The parse resolves the uncovered 'Northcove lanterns' modifier as (LocatedIn $x northcove), a containment relation the text does not state (the lanterns could be from, of, or in the style of Northcove); it sits in the premise as a restriction rather than a top-level assertion, which limits the damage. 'never' → the strength-0.0 distributing rule with its QuantifierPhrase companion, the In-oblique for the circumstantial PP, and keeping that PP inside the denied bundle all follow the instruction set.
